sections.st: Pharmaceutical Thermoforming Packaging — GMP, Cleanroom Class 8, ISO 9001:2015 · Vapi Gujarat
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures pharmaceutical thermoforming packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom thermoformed packaging components for the complete pharmaceutical product range. Pharmaceutical packaging manufacturer from Vapi for ampoule and vial trays, syringe trays and holders, sample kit packaging, strip and sachet packaging, diagnostic kit packaging, sterile packaging solutions, child-resistant packaging, and tamper-proof packaging. As a pharmaceutical thermoforming packaging manufacturer from India, we serve pharmaceutical companies, pharma exporters, and diagnostic kit manufacturers across India and for export.

Pharmaceutical packaging requires GMP-documented manufacturing, cleanroom production for sterile packaging components, and material compatibility with pharmaceutical sterilization methods. Trizen manufactures the thermoformed packaging component — the blister base tray, vial tray, syringe tray, or diagnostic kit tray. Drug filling, foil sealing, batch printing, and serialisation are performed by the pharmaceutical manufacturer at their GMP-validated facility.

sections.st: Why Pharmaceutical Thermoforming Packaging Requires Specialist Manufacturing

strips.title: GMP Manufacturing — Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Documentation Requirements
strips.desc: Pharmaceutical thermoforming packaging that forms part of the finished dosage form packaging system must be manufactured under GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) with documented procedures, material traceability, batch records, and quality release. All pharmaceutical packaging production at Trizen is under GMP with ISO 9001:2015 documentation — batch records, material CoA, and dimensional inspection records per production batch.

strips.title: Pharmaceutical Blister Packaging — Component Manufacture Only
strips.desc: Pharmaceutical blister packaging covers the thermoformed blister base component — the tray into which tablets or capsules are filled by the pharmaceutical manufacturer. Trizen manufactures the thermoformed base tray component (PVC, PVDC-coated PVC, or APET) — drug filling, aluminium foil lidding, and heat sealing are performed by the pharmaceutical manufacturer at their GMP-validated facility.

strips.title: Cleanroom Class 8 — Sterile Pharmaceutical Packaging Components
strips.desc: Pharmaceutical packaging components that form part of sterile drug delivery packaging (ampoule trays, vial trays, syringe trays) must be manufactured in cleanroom conditions. Our Cleanroom Class 8 facility at Vapi produces all sterile pharmaceutical packaging components with particulate control documentation per production run.

strips.title: Tamper-Evidence and Child-Resistance — Regulatory Compliance Requirements
strips.desc: Pharmaceutical packaging in regulated markets requires tamper-evident packaging (Schedule M compliance, FDA requirements) and child-resistant packaging (CPSC 16 CFR 1700, Schedule G compliance). Trizen manufactures thermoformed pharmaceutical packaging components that are designed to be compatible with the pharmaceutical manufacturer's tamper-evidence and child-resistance packaging validation.
